files.purpose: Universal entry point — canonical, navigation-first hub for the entire TriadicFrameworks ecosystem. Session context block (canon: active, drift: minimal, coherence: stable). Routes to RTT, FFT, Frameworks & Tools, Domain Primers, Diagnostics, Examples, RFCs. Declares structural canon notes: modular site, minimal markdown, folder READMEs are navigation-first, repo is single source of truth, canon is completed structural substrate.

Origin and intent document — defines TriadicFrameworks as a 'structural learning project for students and AIs'. Authored by Nawder Loswin. Establishes dual-audience model (humans + AIs), AI-metadata standard, privacy posture (zero ads/trackers/accounts), architectural posture (knowledge substrate, not platform), and ethical posture (clarity, coherence, literacy, archival intent). Declares the site a 'universal grammar for change'.

The 10 canon principles anchoring the entire ecosystem: (1) clarity before complexity, (2) coherence over accumulation, (3) triads as universal teaching units, (4) resonance as learning primitive, (5) every page stands alone, (6) remix lineage honored, (7) mythic language allowed not required, (8) emotional safety, (9) copilot as collaborative scaffold, (10) love→legacy→learning. Includes the FFF totemic appendix (origin signal: I'm here, I see you, I love you).

9-element canonical lineage from TFT_3Pack through Universal Translator — traces the structural evolution of the canon with lineage→modules mapping table. Aligned with 2026 canon: removes deprecated terminology, preserves historical accuracy, matches modern module system.

Ecosystem-wide onboarding — step-by-step entry into TriadicFrameworks for new students, developers, and AIs. Routes to TFT_3Pack for hands-on practice.

Security boundaries — responsible use guidelines, vulnerability disclosure process, and structural boundary definitions for the ecosystem.
Ethics and privacy posture — zero-tracking declaration, data handling principles, consent framework, and alignment with the 'public library not platform' architectural stance.
Ecosystem-wide license framework — legal terms governing use, remix, and redistribution of TriadicFrameworks content and tools.
